# Agent Smith

> Agent Smith is an AI QA agent that audits any deployed web app after a deploy:
> a swarm of agents crawls the site with a real browser, tests user flows, and
> returns a scored report plus a ready-to-paste fix prompt for Claude Code or Cursor.

Agent Smith runs autonomous quality-assurance agents over a website you give it.
It performs a real browser crawl, runs functional, UI, UX, security-hygiene and
performance checks, infers the app's primary workflow and actually tries to
complete it (including authenticated, form-filling "write-path" tests), then
produces per-dimension scores, prioritised findings with evidence and a
consolidated fix prompt. It can run from the web app, a REST API, an MCP server,
a CLI, or a post-deploy webhook (audit + regression diff on every deploy).

## What it does
- Audit types: technical · persona journey · authenticated write-path · custom marketplace agent
- Real-browser engine (vendor-neutral CDP, self-hostable) with an honest mock fallback
- Intelligence layer: site-model inference + agentic workflow test + workflow-health score
- Advisor agents (AI): strategy (Néo), sales/CRO (Trinity), design/UI (Oracle), CEO (Morpheus), SEO+GEO (Link)
- Outputs: scores, findings (evidence/repro/cause/fix), screenshots, PDF, fix prompt, shareable report + badge
- Credits-based, with a no-signup instant audit from the homepage

## Key pages
- Home / free instant audit: https://agent-smith-iota.vercel.app/
- Agent marketplace: https://agent-smith-iota.vercel.app/marketplace

## Tech
Next.js, runs on Vercel. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, v0.
